title: Interest Period and Good-Through Date for Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Redemptions During a Reinstatement Period
content:
On a redemption quote for a vehicle repossessed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract, the interest end follows the reinstatement period running on the quote date, and the quote is good through the same day. The reinstatement periods are counted in calendar days from the repossession date (not counted); the state reinstatement period is the one recorded on the contract.

| Recovery and period running on the quote date | Interest runs through, and the quote is good through |
|---|---|
| Involuntary recovery with a recorded state reinstatement period longer than the company reinstatement window for the tier, still running | the last day of the state period |
| Involuntary recovery with no such longer state period, while the company reinstatement window for the tier is still running | the last day of the company window |
| Any other case, including every voluntary surrender | the quote validity period for the tier after the quote date |

Interest is the per diem times the days from the day after the interest-paid-to date through that end.

| Tier | Company reinstatement window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3 | 10 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2, Tier 1 | 15 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 21 |

### Hypothetical cases (repossession on day 0)

| Contract | Quote date | Interest end and good-through date |
|---|---|---|
| Involuntary, Tier 2 (window 15), state period 30 | day 12 | day 30 |
| Involuntary, Tier 2, state period 30 | day 30 | day 30 — the last day is still within the period; the quote is good through the quote date itself |
| Involuntary, Tier 2, state period 0 | day 9 | day 15 |
| Involuntary, Tier 2, state period 0 | day 16 | quote validity period after day 16 |
| Voluntary surrender, state period 30 | day 12 | quote validity period after day 12 |
